definitions.full: H3573. Kushan Rishathayim רִשְׁעָתַ֫יִם כּוּשַׁן proper name, masculine king of Aram Naharaim Judg 3:8 (twice in verse); 3:10 (twice in verse); otherwise unknown, ᵐ5 Ξουσαρσαθαιμ , ᵐ5 L Ξουσανρεσαμωθ . כּוֺשָׁרוֺת see [ כּוֺשָׁרָה ] below כָּשַׁר .
definitions.rootNote: apparently from 3572 and the dual of 7564 ; Cushan of double wickedness;

occurrences.englishText: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.
Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.
Yahweh’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.
